'''Mallow paste''' was made from [[mallow]], a [[Plant/Legends|plant]] cultivated for its roots, which were harvested, dried, and ground into a sweet powder. It was used as a topping for [[Hot chocolate/Legends|hot chocolate]].<ref name="JK">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref>
